description:
Reid Transit Disc WSD | Women's commuter bike

Lightweight, comfortable and built for everyday journeys – the ideal women's commuter bike for travelling to work or school, getting around town and enjoying practical, reliable cycling.

The Reid Bikes Transit Disc WSD bike is designed to make everyday cycling comfortable and convenient, combining a women's-specific frame geometry with lightweight alloy construction and reliable components. Whether you're commuting, running errands or exploring local cycle paths, it offers a versatile and responsive ride for everyday use.

Its lightweight alloy frame features internal cable routing for a clean appearance and added protection against dirt and everyday wear. Paired with 700c wheels and comfortable 42mm tyres, the Reid Bikes Transit Disc WSD delivers a stable, smooth ride across roads, cycle paths and urban streets.

A 14-speed Shimano-style 2x7 drivetrain combines a double front chainset with a 7-speed rear cassette, providing a practical range of gears for flat roads, everyday commutes and moderate hills. Tektro mechanical disc brakes with 160mm rotors deliver dependable stopping power and controlled braking, helping you ride with confidence through changing urban conditions.

Designed with everyday practicality in mind, the Reid Bikes Transit Disc WSD includes mounts for a rear rack and mudguards, making it easy to customise for your daily routine. Add a rear rack and panniers to carry work essentials or shopping, or fit mudguards for extra protection in wet weather.

Finished in teal, the Reid Transit Disc WSD combines practical features, comfortable handling and everyday versatility in a lightweight commuter bike. With multiple frame sizes available, it's easy to find an option suited to your height and preferred fit.

The Reid Bikes Transit Disc WSD bike is ideal for:

Everyday commuters, looking for a lightweight and comfortable bike for travelling to work or school

City and urban riding, with responsive handling and stable 700c wheels for navigating roads and cycle paths

Riders tackling varied routes, with a 14-speed 2x7 drivetrain offering versatile gearing for everyday journeys and moderate hills

Comfort-focused cyclists, with women's-specific frame geometry and wide 42mm tyres for a stable, comfortable ride

Confident everyday braking, with Tektro mechanical disc brakes and 160mm rotors for dependable stopping power and control

Practical everyday transport, with rack and mudguard mounts for adding panniers, luggage and weather protection

Riders who value durability and convenience, with a lightweight 6061 alloy frame and internally routed cables

Women looking for the right fit, with multiple frame sizes to help find a comfortable riding position

Anyone seeking an alternative to driving, offering a practical way to commute, run errands and enjoy more time on two wheels
